claim: A whole Sinclair alt ROM image removes dependence on NextZXOS's ROM3, whose bytes can differ from what the game reads.

evidence.text: Whole alt ROM image in both builds; start is the snapshot's own BASIC, no stub.
Whole alt ROM image: build starts from the TOSEC snapshot's own BASIC (PAUSE 0, RANDOMIZE USR 51200).
Pinned build over ROM3 reads 89 ROM data bytes that differ; demonstrated in simulation, not hardware.
Default runs the Next's own ROM3 (no alt ROM); 5 to 10 ROM bytes it uses differ.
